title: What is Django?
description: Discover the philosophy behind Django and why it’s the web framework for perfectionists with deadlines.

slides.title: What is a Web Framework? 🏗️
slides.content:
# Web Frameworks Explained

Imagine building a house from scratch: you’d need to mix cement, cut wood, and wire electricity. **A web framework is like a pre‑built house frame** – it gives you the walls, roof, and rooms so you can focus on the **interior design** (your unique features).

Django is a **high‑level Python web framework** that includes:
- **ORM** (Object‑Relational Mapper) to talk to databases.
- **URL routing** to direct requests.
- **Template engine** for dynamic HTML.
- **Admin interface** automatically generated.
- **Security** features out of the box.

quizData.question: What is the main purpose of a web framework?

options.text: To replace the need for Python
To provide a structure and common tools for building web applications
To compile Python code to JavaScript
To host your website on the internet

quizData.explanation: A web framework gives you a structured foundation (routing, database access, templates) so you don't reinvent the wheel every time.

slides.title: Django’s Philosophy ✨
slides.content:
## The "Batteries‑included" Approach

Django comes with **everything you need** to build a full‑featured web app:

- **Authentication** (users, passwords, permissions)
- **Admin site** (manage data without coding)
- **Sitemaps**, **RSS feeds**, **caching** – all built‑in.

> **Don’t Repeat Yourself (DRY)** – Django encourages reusing code and avoiding redundancy.

quizData.question: Django requires you to write SQL queries for every database operation.
quizData.explanation: False! Django’s ORM allows you to interact with the database using Python code – it generates the SQL for you.

slides.title: Pro Tip 💡
slides.content:
## Django powers some of the world’s largest sites

Instagram, Pinterest, and Mozilla all use Django because it scales beautifully and prioritizes security.
